newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU economic confidence at 7-year high in July.
newsitem.headline: EU economic confidence at 7-year high in July.

text.p: Economic sentiment among consumers and businesses in the European Union rose to its highest level in seven years in July, the European Commission said on Tuesday.

"The overall improvement in the monthly results of industry was confirmed by the better results for the inflow of new orders and for capacity utilisation," the EU executive said in its monthly survey of business and consumer confidence.
The July figure, which includes the views of those in the construction sector, rose to 102.8, up a full point from the June reading.
Among consumers, the survey found a marked willingness to buy durable goods, which may be due to a "better outlook for growth and employment".
In Germany, the sentiment gauge posted one of its sharpest advances in years, up to 100.0 in July from 99.3 in June.
France also put in an impressive result, with the index rising to 101.9 from 101.3.
